summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K attaching a notice of redemption for its Series 199 6.527% Senior Preferred Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Notes due 2027. The issuer will redeem all $1,000,000,000 outstanding principal on November 7, 2026 at 100% of par plus accrued interest to, but excluding, that date, with payment via The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch, and DTC surrender procedures. Interest ceases accruing on the optional redemption date. This is a routine debt refinancing/liability-management action, not a special situation; watch for any replacement issuance or capital impact.
